flags: cos(theta*) endpoints adjusted from exact +/-1.0 to +/-0.999 because EXCLURAD's integrator fails at the poles
beam energy defaulted to 6.53 GeV (CLAS12 RG-K, the validated eta campaign); other CLAS12 energies (10.6, 10.2 GeV) are valid but give different radiative corrections
rc_mode set to 0 (full O(alpha)), the only mode used for validated eta results
explanation: Requested a 5-step scan of cos(theta*) in [-1, +1] for eta electroproduction at W=1.7 GeV (above the 1.4861 GeV threshold), Q2=1.5 GeV^2, phi*=90 deg. The literal endpoints -1 and +1 are excluded by a known EXCLURAD quirk (integration diverges exactly at the poles), so they were replaced with -0.999 and +0.999; the interior points (-0.5, 0, 0.5) are unchanged. All 5 points passed preflight (threshold, Q2 coverage, table grid, beam accessibility) at the default beam energy of 6.53 GeV with vcut=0.166 GeV^2. One input file with all 5 points was generated in full O(alpha) radiative-correction mode.
